The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] '''Oovo IV''' was home to [[Desolation Alley]], a maximum security federal prison for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a well known podrace track. It orbited the gas giant [[Oovo]] in an [[Oovo asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] in the Outer Rim. Energy shields protected the prison and kept the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in, and access was tightly restricted. This prison was used for persons who committed severe crimes and thus were tightly guarded.

==History==
[[File:OovoVI_RacerPrima.png|thumb|left|200px|A view on Oovo IV]]
Oovo IV was the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the gas giant [[Oovo]].<ref name="Nint">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref> [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] both attempted to recover the smuggler [[Bendix Fust]] from the heavily guarded prison. Fett entered by following in a transport into the hangar before the energy shields closed again. Losing his own ship, ''[[Jaster's Legacy]]'', Fett stole a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-class patrolship]] that he renamed [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], and escaped with Wesell to deliver Fust to [[Sebolto]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], destroying the remaining ''Firesprays'' by firing missiles into the hangar where they were kept. The prison riot that covered their escape was eventually suppressed. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], after being captured by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], was sent to the prison.

[[Reti]] operated as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] here prior to his involvement with [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the location of the [[Battle of Oovo IV]], which involved [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hurkk]] and at least one [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-owned [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Oovo IV was decimated by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==Security==
The surface entrances and upper levels were guarded by armed soldiers with blasters and laser turrets. But the underground levels, where the worst criminals were kept, needed even stricter control. Thus, special riot guards patrolled those areas. These riot guards were armed with nothing but their fists, but reduced most chances of a successful riot organized from the inside as the guards were highly trained, and could cause fatal damage on anyone who attempted a breakout. During emergencies, however, these guards were free to join their fellows in using numerous crowd-suppression weapons ranging from heavy blasters to charged stun pikes. Jango Fett would eventually encounter such guards as he broke out of the prison after his mission. Some droids were used as security, hovering about 1 foot in the air.

==Podracing==
[[File:OovoIV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The podracing course of Oovo IV]]
Due to its combination of low gravity and artificial atmosphere, [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] was extremely popular throughout the asteroid and its prison, though it was also very dangerous for the contestants. It was one of the few places where the sport had not been outlawed. Three other examples of these planets are [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], [[Aquilaris]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The asteroid was the setting for at least four race courses, including [[Vengeance (Oovo IV)|Vengeance]], [[Executioner (course)/Legends|Executioner]], and [[The Gauntlet (Podrace course)/Legends|The Gauntlet]]. An [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]] lived near Executioner. The home crowd favorites were [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], [[Fud Sang/Legends|Fud Sang]] and [[Toy Dampner]].
